display_long_description:
Cooking has never been this dangerous! Slice Chef brings the addictive thrill of 'survivor' style games to VR.

It’s harvest time, but the crops are fighting back. Set in a vibrant farm world, you must help your determined little chef fend off an endless army of mutant vegetables. Tomatoes, cucumbers, and eggplants are swarming from every direction, and the only way out is to slice through them!

Key Features:

Roguelite Survival: Defeat waves of enemies to collect XP and level up instantly. Every run is unique!

Strategic Upgrades: Choose wisely from random power-up cards. Will you boost your Movement Speed, add more spinning Slicers, or increase Health Regeneration? Create powerful combos to become unstoppable.

Horde Combat: Face hundreds of angry veggies on screen at once. Experience the satisfaction of clearing massive crowds with your upgraded arsenal.

God-View VR: Oversee the battlefield from a comfortable third-person perspective, giving you the perfect tactical view to dodge attacks and find safe paths.

Vibrant Style: Enjoy colorful, low-poly graphics that make the chaos look fun and satisfying.

Sharpen your knives and get ready for the ultimate food fight. Can you survive the garden in Slice Chef?
